recreation_prompt_markdown: Recreate a mobile-first browser ludo-like board race called Ludo Mooncourt Bestie Roll. Use a 10x10 serpentine 100-square canvas board, 1 human plus configurable CPU players, dice 1-6 roll-and-move turns, five upward charm boosts, six downward drama ribbons, and a tile-100 win state. Present it as satirical candycore magical-girl pixel art with crescent tokens, sugar squares, meme copy like "real" and "bestie", large one-thumb roll controls, and portrait readability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

Source reality: a browser canvas ludo/snakes-and-ladders style board race. The game uses a 10x10 serpentine board, random upward/downward connectors, 1-8 players, one human token, CPU auto-roll turns, dice values 1-6, movement interpolation, connector effects, tile 100 finish, options, audio toggles, fast mode, haptics, and restart/menu flows.

Protected mechanics: board size and serpentine indexing, dice roll range, turn sequencing, CPU automation, connector counts and direction semantics, finish condition, no capture mechanic, player count bounds, color picker, settings toggles, and mobile roll button input.

Remix target: Ludo Mooncourt Bestie Roll, a candycore pixel-art magical board race with satirical moon-court copy and sugarcore procedural visuals while retaining the original ludo-like rules.
